docs.title: Self-Introduction
docs.text:
Hi everyone, my name is Li Jinxuan.

I was born in Leshan, Sichuan, but I grew up in Xinyang, Henan during my childhood.

I moved here six years ago when I was in junior high school, and I have grown up here since then. It was hard to get used to a new place. I'm really grateful to my grandma. She brought me up for ten years. I used to very easily complain about any little thing, and my grandma always tried to cheer me up.

Now I'm a student at Chengdu Technological University.

To be honest, I used to think I'm good at nothing, but actually I'm good at adapting to new environments and staying patient with myself. That's pretty much about me. Thanks for listening.

Suggested simpler expressions:

  • It was hard to get used to a new place.
  • I really appreciate my grandma for raising me.
  • I used to complain a lot, but she always encouraged me.

docs.title: Chlidhood
docs.text:
I grew up in a small country, but there were so many interesting things.

My family always had cats and dogs. One of the dogs I remember most is a little black and yellow dog named Huanhuan, because he could bring everyone happiness.

I just loved that dog, and he loved me too. Every time I came back from school, Huanhuan remembered me. His tail would swing, and he wanted to shake hands with me. It was hard to forget him.

I had a lot of friends. I used to spend time with them and hang out until the sky turned dark. We always had a great time.

Those days are just memories now.

Suggested simpler expressions:

  • I grew up in a small town, but there was always something fun to do.
  • One dog I'll never forget is a little black-and-yellow one named Huanhuan — he made everyone happy.
  • He'd wag his tail and try to shake my paw every day after school.
  • I hung out with friends until it got dark.
  • Those days are just memories now.

docs.title: Transportation
docs.text:
Which way do you prefer - public or private?

I prefer public transportation.

I think the biggest advantage is that it's very convenient in big cities. In Chengdu, there's Subway Line 7, which is a circle line in the subway system. It connects many stations and helps people get to anywhere they want.

There is also a very good bus system. The buses have different routes and usually arrive on time. Public transportation is really not expensive, so visitors can have a great time without spending too much money.

So, public transportation is more convenient and finance-friendly in big cities.

Suggested simpler expressions:

  • The biggest advantage is convenience.
  • The subway and buses cover almost everywhere.
  • It's cheap, so tourists can save money.

docs.title: Ideal House
docs.text:
My ideal house has a very large open living room that connects the kitchen and dining room. you can share breakfast with sunshine every morning.

Go upstairs and turn left, you'll see three bedrooms and a shared hallway bathroom. it's dark enough there, so you don't need to wear a blindfold before going to bed.

The key spaces are a two-car garage and a backyard with a swimming pool. A fancy way to enjoy it is to drink beer while having a barbecue in the backyard.

This is my ideal house. Thank you for listening.

Suggested simpler expressions:

  • The living room is open and bright.
  • The bedrooms are nice and dark for sleeping.
  • I'd love to have a pool and a garage for two cars.

docs.title: Change
docs.text:
I couldn't speak Sichuanese at all, and my parents told me that if I find a job around here in the future, it's better to learn how to speak it. I didn't want to speak it because no one talked to me. But a man can change. And I was really sick of talking to my roommates in a strange atmosphere. In summer, I decided to go into the wet market, talk with vendors, and ask how much things cost. It wasn't easy at first. I learned the price list of meats and vegetables by the end of summer. Summer ends, things change. Now I can talk to my roommates in Sichuanese in a comfortable way. That's my change. Thanks.

Suggested simpler expressions:

  • My parents encouraged me to learn it for future jobs.
  • I felt awkward speaking with my roommates before.
  • Practicing at the market really helped me improve.
